MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Dance: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Dance.
   C. Damage equipment used for Dance.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Dance.

2. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the volume
   B. The ticket price
   C. The speed of the music
   D. Only the costume

3. Best practice when working on Songs: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Songs.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Songs.
   C. Damage equipment used for Songs.
   D. Practise Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. Best practice when working on Singing Games: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Singing Games.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Singing Games.
   C. Practise Singing Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Singing Games.

5. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   B. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Melody.

6. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Guarantee a trophy
   B. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   C. Remove the need for rules
   D. Replace drinking water

7. Best practice when working on Elements of Music RESPONDING: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Elements of Music RESPONDING.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Elements of Music RESPONDING.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Elements of Music RESPONDING.
   D. Practise Elements of Music RESPONDING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Red, blue, and yellow
   B. Black, white, and grey
   C. Green, orange, and purple
   D. Brown, pink, and gold

9. Best practice when working on Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Musical Instruments.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Musical Instruments.
   C. Practise Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Musical Instruments.

10. Best practice when working on Rhythm COMPOSING: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Rhythm COMPOSING.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm COMPOSING.
   C. Practise Rhythm COMPOSING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm COMPOSING.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Songs and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Singing Games and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Musical Instruments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Dance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Rhythm COMPOSING and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Melody and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Elements of Music RESPONDING and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Songs and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
